assumptions.assumption: The Postgres database data is confidential because it contains customer personal information and order history.
assumptions.basis: The store contains customer names, delivery addresses, phone numbers, and order history.

assumptions.assumption: The S3 bucket data is confidential because it contains order summaries derived from customer orders.
assumptions.basis: The bucket stores summaries written from orders.

assumptions.assumption: The audit log data is confidential because it contains administrative actions concerning customer and order data.
assumptions.basis: The API writes each administrative action to the audit log.

assumptions.assumption: The React single-page web app is internet-facing because it is served to the public internet.
assumptions.basis: The web app is served from CloudFront to the public internet.

assumptions.assumption: The Orders API presents a web interface because the web app calls it over HTTPS.
assumptions.basis: The web app calls the Orders API over HTTPS.

assumptions.assumption: The admin console presents a web interface because administrators use it over HTTPS.
assumptions.basis: Support administrators use an admin console over HTTPS.

assumptions.assumption: The Auth0 identity provider is in a tenant boundary because it is an external identity provider.
assumptions.basis: The text identifies Auth0 as the identity provider external to the described system.

assumptions.assumption: Stripe is in a tenant boundary because it is an external payment service.
assumptions.basis: Payment authorization goes to the separately named Stripe service.

assumptions.assumption: CloudFront is in a tenant boundary because it is a separately controlled hosting and delivery service.
assumptions.basis: The application is served from the separately named CloudFront service.
